{{Top|leg}}
'''Quaska''' was a location probably associated with the underworld. It was used in a form of profanity: "Rot in Qasak!", which held a similar meaning to the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] imprecation "Rot in [[Boboqueequee/Legends|Boboqueequee]]!"

==Behind the scenes==
"Rot in Qasak!" is probably an equivalent of "Burn in Hell!"
